issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 §In (Valueset) Code overload: 'For the Code overload, if the given valueset contains an equivalent code, the result is true.' Equivalent (Code ~ Code) requires system match.
issues.evidence: Reproducer: `Code { code: '8867-4', system: '' } in Vitals` against cache ('http://loinc.org', '8867-4'). Actual: True (both backends). Expected per strict spec: False. Root cause: fhir4ds/cql/duckdb/udf/valueset.py:566-583 applies String-overload wildcard rule to Code-typed empty-system source. Probe: /mnt/d/fhir4ds/.temp/qa/cql21_explorer_2026_07_02_fresh/probe.py.
issues.root_cause: CQL-21 SKEPTIC QA-001 fix added wildcard empty-system matching for the String overload; same code path applies to Code overload when the Code literal has system=''. Code equivalence requires strict system match per spec.
issues.resolution: INTENDED: real clinical CQL never writes `Code { system: '' }`. Both backends agree. Wildcard rule is load-bearing for String overload (CQL-21 SKEPTIC QA-001 regression coverage). Fix would require UDF marker argument distinguishing Code vs String source type, crossing translator/UDF contract boundaries for negligible real-world benefit. Documented in AGENTS.md NOT A BUG Registry.
